# Adagio Therapy Center
> Josh English, LCSW offers attachment-based, trauma-informed therapy for individuals and couples in Bend, Oregon, and by HIPAA-secure telehealth throughout Oregon. 17+ years of experience; trained in IFS, EMDR, and Emotionally Focused Therapy.

- Fee: $200 per session; free 15-minute consultation
- Insurance: Kaiser Permanente, Regence BCBS, PacificSource, Oregon Health Plan, First Choice Health, Samaritan Health
- Office: 1230 NE 3rd St., Suite A160, Office D, Bend, OR 97701
- Phone: 503-985-8252
- Services: https://www.adagiotherapy.org/individual-therapy-bend/ , https://www.adagiotherapy.org/couples-therapy-bend/ , https://www.adagiotherapy.org/intensive-couples-weekend-bend/ , https://www.adagiotherapy.org/supervision/
- FAQ: https://www.adagiotherapy.org/faq/
